model_call_location: The model call (LLM inference) happens strictly on the Host/Client side between tools/list (when tool schemas are injected into model context) and tools/call (when the model selects a tool and generates its arguments); the model NEVER runs inside the MCP Server.

hand_annotations.jsonrpc: Specifies JSON-RPC protocol version 2.0; must be exact string '2.0' for standard compliance.
hand_annotations.id: Unique request identifier (integer 1) assigned by client to match incoming asynchronous server responses.
hand_annotations.method: The RPC method name being invoked: 'initialize' initiates the MCP protocol handshake.
hand_annotations.params: Object containing client metadata: 'protocolVersion' (agreed MCP spec version 2024-11-05), client 'capabilities' (supported MCP extensions like sampling and roots), and 'clientInfo' (identifying the client application and version).

hand_annotations.jsonrpc: Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope string confirming protocol framing.
hand_annotations.id: Matches request identifier (1), allowing the client to correlate this handshake reply with its initial request.
hand_annotations.result: Payload returned on success containing negotiated 'protocolVersion', server 'capabilities' (advertising tool support without dynamic change notifications), and 'serverInfo' declaring vendor provenance.

hand_annotations.method: Specifies 'notifications/initialized', signaling to the server that client-side initialization is complete and regular requests may now commence.
hand_annotations.id: Intentionally OMITTED: Per JSON-RPC 2.0 specification, notifications have no ID and do not solicit or expect any server response.
Unique request identifier (integer 2) for tracking the tool enumeration call.
hand_annotations.method: MCP method 'tools/list' requesting the server's catalog of callable tools.
hand_annotations.params: Empty parameter object (can optionally hold cursor strings for paginated tool catalogs).

tools.name: get_ingredient_details
tools.description: Lookup official ingredient specifications by ingredient name. Exposes comprehensive allergen flags, food category, and storage instructions from the content team's ingredient database.

ingredient_name.description: The common or culinary name of the ingredient (e.g. 'heavy cream', 'coconut cream', 'parmesan cheese')

tools.name: get_nutrition_facts
tools.description: Retrieves verified nutritional profile (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sodium) per 100g or scaled to specified quantity in grams.

ingredient_name.description: Name of the ingredient to query nutrition for

quantity_g.description: Optional quantity in grams to calculate total nutrients for (defaults to 100g)

hand_annotations.id: Corresponds to request ID 2 from the client's tools/list inquiry.
hand_annotations.result: Contains the 'tools' array describing each capability: tool name, functional docstring/description, and standard JSON Schema 'inputSchema' defining expected arguments and required fields.

hand_annotations.id: Unique request identifier (integer 3) to correlate with tool execution output.
hand_annotations.method: MCP method 'tools/call' directing the server to execute a specific discovered tool.
hand_annotations.params: Object detailing the execution: 'name' specifies target tool ('get_nutrition_facts'), and 'arguments' supplies model-generated key-value parameters matching inputSchema.

hand_annotations.id: Matches request identifier 3 from the client's tools/call request.
hand_annotations.result: Execution payload containing 'content' array (text blocks with serialized JSON observation) and 'isError' boolean flag (false indicates successful culinary lookup).
